2121525508852666790.en_summary: $NBIS Path for NBIS to $1,000. Currently ~$115, market cap ~$34B. To $1,000 needs $280–300B cap or 8-9×. 2026 revenue ~$3.0–3.2B, 2027 guidance $12–13B (4×) with pre-tax break-even in Q4. Longer term ramp to multi-GW by ~2030 could drive revenue to $40-60B+. At $50B revenue and 5–6× sales, market cap ~$250-300B or 850-1,050/share (limited dilution). Supports: strong customer prepayments, vertical integration, high AI demand. Risks: build delays, funding/dilution from $40B+ annual capex, competition, demand slowdown. $1,000 is multi-year bull-case, not near-term. Some call for $2,000+. Took long position this week after 54% drop in a month on strong revenue projections. DYOR.
